title: MacacoView
brief: Visual redesign of pc-ai-monitor as MacacoView (GTK4 + libadwaita). 01 plus visual alternatives: 04 and 05 (~85% less text), and 06 combining 01 + 04 + 05 at ~60% less text.

artboards.title: Cabina densa
artboards.tradeoff: Today's shell, densest and cheapest to build; everything in words and numbers (6 625 chars)

artboards.title: Cabina visual · medidores
artboards.tradeoff: Instruments instead of words: arc gauges, rings, RAM blocks, version rail; -88% text, details in tooltips; several new Cairo widgets

artboards.title: Cabina visual · línea de tiempo
artboards.tradeoff: Six lanes on one 15-min axis with events and a shared cursor; -88% text; heaviest to build, needs a 15-min history buffer

artboards.title: Cabina combinada (01 + 04 + 05)
artboards.tradeoff: 01's shell and exact values, 04's instruments for now, 05's motor band and decode/prefill lanes; ~74% less text than 01 with labels and units kept; builds most new widgets of 04 and 05

artboards.title: Cabina combinada · animada (prototipo)
artboards.tradeoff: Live prototype of 06: one simulation clock, demo remote (play/pause, 1×/5×/20×) and 10 scenarios; Motores carries every element of today's real blocks; the other pages arrive in a second pass
